opening_circle — 2D region op

• Data kinds: region → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "opening_circle", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: opening_circle (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Binary opening with a disk-shaped structuring element (erosion followed by dilation). Removes small protrusions and thin connections while preserving the overall shape. Corresponds to HALCON's `opening_circle` (Open a region with a circular structuring element).
